TL;DR: COMPASS是一种推理时引导方法，通过模型自身直接答案的正确性信号，识别并干预少数关键注意力头的激活，以激发推理能力。该方法仅需每头激活统计信息，在多个数学基准上显著提升性能，平均提升GSM8K准确率16个百分点，接近CoT效果但生成令牌减少20-70%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法依赖预定义的推理表征，如CoT提示设计或SAE提取的推理特征，而这些方式复杂且难以泛化。本文提出更简单的信号——模型自身直接答案的正确性，即可有效激发推理行为，从而降低对复杂设计的依赖。

Method: 利用模型在数学问题中直接输出答案的正确性作为监督信号，挖掘出一个可解码的潜在方向（即正确性方向）。通过在推理阶段计算logit空间的归因分数，识别出少数能有效承载该方向的关键注意力头，并对其激活进行干预，实现高效推理引导。

Result: 在三个模型家族和多个数学基准测试中，COMPASS优于现有激活干预基线；平均提升GSM8K准确率16个百分点，接近CoT表现但使用更少生成令牌；干预具有跨任务迁移能力，且仅有少量头部起作用，证明了正确性方向与特定头部的必要性。

Conclusion: 模型自身答案的正确性是一个强大且简洁的推理激发信号。通过识别并干预少数关键注意力头，COMPASS实现了高效的推理引导，具备高效率、强泛化性和可解释性，为轻量级推理增强提供了新范式。

Abstract: Explicitly eliciting reasoning substantially improves LLM performance. Existing approaches require a predefined characterization of reasoning, whether through CoT prompt design, contrastive CoT directions, or via SAE derived reasoning features. For mathematical reasoning with verifiable answers, we show that a much simpler signal suffices, which is the correctness of the model's own direct answer attempts. This signal yields a latent direction that elicits reasoning. This direction is decodable within the activations of most attention heads, but only a small subset of them can be effectively intervened. We introduce COMPASS, an inference-time steering method that identifies these heads using a logit-space attribution score and steers their activations along the correctness direction, requiring only per-head activation statistics. Across three model families and multiple math benchmarks, COMPASS outperforms the activation-steering baselines we compare against, improves GSM8K accuracy by 16 percentage points on average, and approaches CoT accuracy with 20-70\% fewer generated tokens. Interventions transfer without re-fitting to unseen benchmarks, and ablations show that both the correctness direction and the small set of heads carrying it are necessary, with the effect concentrated in remarkably few heads.

</details>


### [258] [PsyCIDRA: A Dual-Agent Framework for Psychiatric Interviewing and Diagnostic Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07473)
*Milad Mohammadi,Fatemeh Akrami Shamsabadi,Zahra Mohseni,Amirhossein Safdarian,Malekfarhad Malek,Hadi Moradi,Hesham Faili*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: PsyCIDRA is a dual-agent framework that uses large language models (LLMs) to support psychiatric interviewing and diagnostic reasoning. The interviewer agent guides conversations using tools for note-taking, expert skills, and ICD-11 references, while the diagnostic agent evaluates the interview transcript and generates hypotheses with supporting, conflicting, and missing evidence. Evaluated in simulations and human studies, PsyCIDRA outperforms direct prompting in diagnostic agreement and accuracy, showing strong potential for assisting psychiatric assessment through interactive dialogue.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Psychiatric interviewing requires dynamic, evolving conversations, but the ability of large language models (LLMs) to support such interactive assessment remains underexplored. There is a need for systems that can guide interviews effectively and reason about diagnoses safely, especially in complex clinical contexts.

Method: PsyCIDRA employs two LLM agents: an interviewer agent that uses tools to maintain working notes, access expert-written skills, and retrieve ICD-11 references during free-form interviews; and a diagnostic reasoning agent that analyzes the completed interview transcript to generate diagnostic hypotheses with evidence evaluation. The system was tested in simulated patient cases using PsyCPG-generated profiles and validated in a blinded study with 101 human participants across different conditions.

Result: In simulation, PsyCIDRA achieved higher diagnostic agreement than direct prompting across four models on 53 cases, with rank-1 accuracy of 60.5% versus 51.9% on 81 held-out cases. In the human study, it agreed with psychologists on whether to propose a diagnosis in 79.6% of cases, compared to 65.4% for direct prompting.

Conclusion: The results demonstrate that LLM-based dual-agent frameworks like PsyCIDRA can effectively assist psychiatric assessment by combining interactive interviewing with structured diagnostic reasoning. This approach improves both diagnostic accuracy and safety, offering a promising direction for integrating AI into clinical psychiatry.

Abstract: Large language models show promise in clinical reasoning, but psychiatric interviewing requires guiding an evolving conversation. Their ability to carry out this interactive assessment remains less studied. We present PsyCIDRA, a dual-agent framework linking free-form psychiatric interviewing with diagnostic reasoning for expert review. Its interviewer agent uses tools to maintain working notes, load expert-written skills, and retrieve ICD-11 references to guide inquiry. Its diagnostic reasoning agent then receives the completed interview transcript and reports hypotheses alongside supporting, conflicting, and missing evidence, withholding a final hypothesis when none is sufficiently supported. Using patient profiles generated with PsyCPG, we first evaluate PsyCIDRA in simulation. Across four models on 53 evaluation cases, it achieves higher diagnostic agreement than direct prompting. On 81 held-out simulated cases, rank-1 accuracy is 60.5% versus 51.9%. In a blinded study of 101 human participants in separate arms, PsyCIDRA agrees with psychologists on whether to propose a diagnostic hypothesis in 79.6% of cases, compared with 65.4% for direct prompting. Together, these findings support the potential of LLM agents to assist psychiatric assessment through free-form dialogue. By examining diagnostic reasoning, interview quality, and safety together, this study contributes to understanding the capabilities and limitations of psychiatric interview agents.

</details>


### [259] [In With the Old: Enhancing 'Classical' Document Automation with Generative AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07480)
*Marc Lauritsen,Hannes Westermann*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文探讨了基于专家系统风格和符号方法的文档自动化服务如何与当前生成式AI方法相互增强。研究讨论了潜在优势与挑战，并报告了初步实验，利用大语言模型识别并修正非专业人士撰写的文本中的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 旨在探索如何将传统符号推理方法与生成式AI结合，以提升法律文书自动化系统的性能和可用性，尤其针对非专业人士撰写的文本进行改进。

Method: 通过结合专家系统和符号方法的文档自动化技术，利用大语言模型分析和修复普通人撰写的法律相关文本中的错误或不一致之处。

Result: 初步实验表明，大语言模型能够有效识别并修正非专业人士在法律文本中常见的表述错误、逻辑漏洞和用词不当等问题，提升了文本质量与可读性。

Conclusion: 生成式AI可以显著增强传统法律文档自动化系统的能力，同时这些系统也为生成式AI提供结构化知识支持，二者具有互补潜力，未来应进一步融合发展。

Abstract: Software-based legal assistance systems have leveraged many different forms of knowledge representation and reasoning. This article explores how document automation services rooted in expert system style and other symbolic approaches can usefully enhance and be enhanced by current generative AI approaches. We discuss the possible benefits and challenges, and report on preliminary experiments in using large language models to identify and fix issues in texts written by laypeople.

</details>


### [260] [Does Muon Need Fine-Grained Spectral Shaping?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07497)
*Meher Chaitanya,Tianyi Zhou,Aristides Gionis*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Muon优化器通过矩阵动量结合当前和历史梯度，其理想更新方向为所有奇异方向权重相同（平坦谱）。本文提出两带谱重加权框架BulkBoost，通过噪声校准的马尔琴科-帕斯图尔边缘分离主成分与噪声，提升主成分权重，同时保持各方向弗罗贝尼乌斯范数不变。理论分析表明，将权重向主成分集中可降低损失；实验显示，两带方案在30个预训练任务中优于细粒度谱方法Freon和Spectra，相比原版Muon平均降低0.073%-0.147%损失，显著优于仅0.022%的Freon改进。结果表明：有效偏离平坦谱的调整具有极低维度特征，单一带间增益即可捕获大部分优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有优化器通过精细谱映射对不同奇异方向赋予不同增益，但其必要性未被验证。本文旨在探究Muon更新中谱细节的实际需求，揭示是否高维谱调节能带来显著收益。

Method: 提出两带谱重加权框架BulkBoost，包含固定秩与噪声校准两种变体。后者利用分批梯度差估计马尔琴科-帕斯图尔参考边缘，区分主成分与噪声成分，通过统一增益增强主成分相对权重，同时保持各方向原始范数不变。提供理论条件说明权重向主成分转移可降低损失，并量化该策略所能达到的最大改进比例。

Result: 在Pythia 14M至410M模型、6个语料库共30个持续预训练任务中，两带重加权方案性能优于细粒度功率律谱方法Freon（减少损失0.073%-0.147%，而Freon仅0.022%），且显著优于原始Muon的平坦谱。实证表明，有益的谱调整仅需低维结构，单个主成分-噪声带增益即可捕捉绝大部分优势。

Conclusion: 尽管近期优化器采用复杂谱映射，但实际收益主要来自对主成分方向的适度增强。两带重加权机制以极简结构实现显著性能提升，证明有效谱调整是低维的，无需高分辨率谱控制。这为设计更高效、可解释的优化器提供了新思路。

Abstract: Muon combines current and past gradients into matrix momentum. For $M=UΣV^\top$, the idealized polar update $Q=UV^\top$ gives every singular direction the same weight. We refer to this as the flat profile. Several recent optimizers replace this flat profile with fine-grained spectral maps that give each direction its own gain. We ask how much of this spectral detail a Muon update needs. Our spectral diagnostics show that approximately $94$--$97\%$ of measured singular modes lie below an estimated noise edge, yet collectively align positively with a reference gradient.
  We introduce BulkBoost, a two-band spectral reweighting framework with fixed-rank and noise-calibrated variants. The latter uses split-minibatch gradient differences to calibrate a Marchenko--Pastur reference edge for Muon's Nesterov input, separating the bulk below the edge from the spikes above it. Both variants increase the bulk's relative weight through one shared gain while preserving the Frobenius norm of each matrix's unreweighted direction. For a fixed partition, our theory gives the first-order condition under which moving weight toward the bulk lowers the loss. It also quantifies the fraction of the maximal first-order improvement rate, over all per-mode reallocations, that two bands can capture. Across 30 continued-pretraining settings spanning Pythia-14M to 410M and six corpora, two-band reweighting is competitive with the fine-grained power-law profile of Freon and outperforms Spectra. Measured against Muon's flat profile, Freon reduces final loss by $0.022\%$ of the pre-adaptation loss on average, whereas the two-band variants achieve reductions of $0.073$--$0.147\%$. These observations suggest that useful departures from the flat profile are surprisingly low-dimensional: a single bulk-to-spike gain captures at least as much benefit as the fine-grained spectral profiles.

</details>


### [261] [MARS: Multi-resolution Adaptive Routing for Sequential Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07505)
*Ming Yin,Sixun Dong,Yudong Liu,Wen-Yun Yang,Yunjiang Jiang,Yiran Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出MARS，一种多分辨率用户记忆机制，用于解决长历史推荐系统中因单一缓存记忆导致的时序混淆问题。MARS通过不同半衰期的递归状态轨迹记录用户历史，并采用稀疏路由读取器选择相关时间尺度的种子记忆，从而在保持固定大小候选评分的前提下提升推荐性能。实验表明，MARS在三个公开数据集上优于基线模型，尤其在历史较长时优势更明显；组件消融实验显示，时间多样性与选择性路由均带来显著提升。此外，当用户行为发生转变后，MARS相比接口匹配基线在服务延迟上仍具优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有长历史推荐系统使用单一缓存记忆压缩用户历史，但真实用户行为具有多尺度语义结构（短期意图、中期兴趣、长期偏好），而传统方法对不同时段信息的保留不均衡，导致近期和中期内容恢复效果差，出现‘时序混淆’现象。因此需要一种能有效捕捉多尺度时间结构的记忆机制。

Method: 提出MARS框架，包含两个核心模块：1）多分辨率记忆写入：将用户完整历史分阶段写入多个递归状态轨迹，每个轨迹锚定于不同的半衰期，以捕获不同时间尺度的行为模式；2）稀疏路由读取器：根据当前候选特征动态选择最相关的若干时间分辨率作为种子记忆，生成紧凑且上下文相关的记忆表示，支持高效候选评分。

Result: MARS在三个公共数据集上均显著优于强基线模型，性能增益随用户历史长度增加而扩大。消融实验表明，时间多样性与选择性路由分别带来独立贡献，超越硬窗口记忆或单纯增加容量的效果。在用户行为变化后，MARS相较于接口匹配基线，其热缓存服务延迟仅为其约1.02倍，表现出更强的适应性与效率。

Conclusion: MARS通过多分辨率建模与稀疏路由机制，有效缓解了长历史推荐中的时序混淆问题，提升了记忆表达能力与推荐性能，尤其在长序列和动态行为场景下表现突出，为构建高效、鲁棒的用户记忆系统提供了新思路。

Abstract: Long-history recommenders often compress each user's history into a compact, candidate-independent memory that is cached and reused to score large candidate pools. We show that real user histories exhibit multi-scale semantic structure, with short-lived intent, medium-term interests, and long-term preferences coexisting in one sequence, and that monolithic cached memories preserve these scales unevenly: linear probes recover recent and mid-range content far worse than long-range content. We call this failure mode \textit{temporal aliasing}. We propose \textbf{MARS}, a multi-resolution user memory that writes the full history into recurrent state tracks anchored to different half-lives, and a sparse routing reader that materializes compact seed memories by selecting the relevant temporal resolutions for each seed, preserving fixed-size candidate scoring. MARS outperforms strong baselines on three public datasets, with gains that grow with history length. Component-matched ablations with paired tests show that temporal diversity and selective routing each contribute beyond what hard-window memories or added capacity provide. The advantage of MARS over its interface-matched baseline also widens after within-user behavioral shifts, at about $1.02\times$ that baseline's warm-cache serving latency for $1{,}000$ candidates per user.

</details>


### [262] [On Open-Ended Information Seeking for Information Elicitation Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07509)
*Victor De Lima,Grace Hui Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究探讨了不同大语言模型（LLM）在信息获取任务中对信息价值的判断差异，以及这些差异如何影响序列式信息搜索行为。通过对比11个不同家族和参数规模的LLM，作者在受控模拟环境中分析了模型特定的信息寻求偏好，并揭示了其在广度与深度之间的权衡。研究还考察了交互历史对信息评估和选择的影响，并通过敏感性分析验证了结果的稳健性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前信息获取任务中，代理型信息获取依赖大语言模型进行决策，但不同模型如何影响信息寻求行为尚不明确。理解模型选择对信息价值判断及后续行为的影响，有助于优化信息获取系统的设计。

Method: 采用跨11个大语言模型的比较实验，使用统一的信息和目标；构建受控信息获取模拟环境，使各模型在相同信息空间中应用相同选择规则，从而隔离出模型自身对信息价值判断的影响；通过分析交互历史、冗余性等因素变化下的表现，进行敏感性分析与消融实验。

Result: 不同大语言模型表现出显著不同的信息寻求偏好，体现在信息探索的广度与深度上；交互历史显著影响模型对潜在信息的评估与选择；模型行为对输入设置、标签定义和冗余处理具有不同程度的敏感性，表明其行为边界可被识别。

Conclusion: 大语言模型的选择直接影响信息获取过程中的行为模式，其内在的价值判断机制是决定信息探索策略的关键因素。设计高效的信息获取系统需考虑模型特性及其在动态交互中的适应性。

Abstract: Information elicitation is an open-ended information-seeking problem in which an interaction can unfold in many potentially valuable directions, requiring an elicitor to continually determine which information to pursue as new information emerges. In agentic elicitation, these decisions may be delegated to a foundation model, yet how model choice shapes the resulting information-seeking behavior remains understudied. We study how judgments about information value vary across LLMs and how these differences shape sequential information seeking. We first examine these judgments across 11 LLMs spanning multiple model families and parameter scales, using a shared set of information and elicitation objectives. We then develop a controlled elicitation simulation in which different models encounter the same information space and use the same selection rule, isolating these judgments from question generation and respondent behavior. Using this setting, we characterize the breadth-depth behavior that emerges from model-specific information-seeking preferences over the course of elicitation. We further examine how interaction history changes the evaluation and subsequent selection of prospective information. We test the robustness and boundaries of these findings through sensitivity analyses and ablations over the opportunities available to the elicitor, the response labels used to operationalize information-seeking preferences, the presence of interaction history, and whether redundancy is explicitly relevant to the assessment. The project code, data, and trajectory files are available at https://github.com/infosenselab/open-elicitation.

</details>


### [263] [From Local Evidence to Safety Verdicts: Causal Tracing in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07514)
*Faezeh Dehghan Tarzjani,Mevan Wijewardena,Alexander Romanus,Sampad Mohanty*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出SSU-Bench数据集，用于研究视觉-语言模型在联合判断安全风险时的内部机制。通过对比安全与不安全图像-文本组合，分析模型在不同层对输入变化的响应，发现干预早期解码器层更有效，而最终输入标记的干预影响延迟显现。线性读出最终标记状态可预测模型自身判断，包括错误判断，且跨模型模式相似。研究揭示了联合安全判断的可访问性转变点，区分了可读决策与正确安全判断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索视觉-语言模型在联合判断安全风险时，其内部状态如何反映和处理图像与文本的协同信息，特别是当单独的信息无法揭示风险时，需要理解模型中何时何地能访问到这种联合判断。

Method: 构建SSU-Bench数据集，包含通过单个项目编辑生成的安全与不安全图像-文本配对，并标注意图区域。使用三种视觉-语言模型，通过转移内部状态并测量安全判断的变化，分析不同输入位置和层次的干预效果。

Result: 在早期解码器层，针对修改输入位置的干预更有效；而针对最终输入标记的干预则在后期才显现效果。从其他示例估计的方向也产生类似晚期效应。线性读出最终标记状态可准确预测模型自身的判断（包括错误判断）。跨模型比较显示，反事实变化的模式具有相似性。

Conclusion: 研究识别出干预影响联合安全判断的反复出现的转变点，明确了模型决策的可读性与正确安全判断之间的区别，为理解模型内部安全推理提供了关键洞见。

Abstract: A vision-language model may need to combine an image with a prompt to recognize a safety risk that neither reveals alone. Where does this joint safety judgment become accessible inside the model? We introduce SSU-Bench, a dataset of matched safe and unsafe image-text combinations constructed using single-item prompt edits or image edits with annotated intended regions. Using three vision-language models, we transfer internal states between paired inputs and measure the resulting change in the safety verdict. Across models and both types of counterfactual, interventions at the changed input positions are effective in earlier decoder layers, while interventions at the final input token become effective later. Directions estimated from other examples produce similar late-layer effects. A linear readout of the final-token state also predicts the model's own verdict, including incorrect judgments, and cross-model comparisons reveal similarities in the patterns of counterfactual change. These findings identify a recurring transition in where interventions can influence a joint safety verdict and distinguish a readable model decision from a correct safety judgment.

</details>


### [264] [Grounding What Shapes the Plan: Rethinking Groundedness for Physical Intelligence in Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07521)
*Minkyoung Cho,Zewei Zhou,Wenhao Ding,Shuhan Tan,Boyi Li,Yuxiao Chen,Yan Wang,Zheng Lian,Min-Hung Chen,Chaowei Xiao,Zhuoqing Mao,Boris Ivanovic,Marco Pavone,Yulong Cao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: GroundAct提出以物理实体及其交互作为驾驶推理的根基，通过轻量级引用标记保持实体状态可符号化推理，并仅通过这些实体与动态规划的交互来修正计划，实现从推理到行动的显式映射，即‘接地规划’。在开环和闭环设置下均表现出色，尤其在正常、分布外及高安全风险场景中表现优异，闭环仿真结果进一步验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前驾驶模型虽将推理建立在因果关系、空间结构、感知证据和未来预测之上，但未解决推理‘接地’与最终动作输出之间的关联问题：正确的推理并不保证理想的驾驶结果。因此需要一种能明确连接推理与行动的机制。

Method: 提出GroundAct框架，以物理实体为推理单位，引入轻量级引用标记持续追踪实体状态，仅通过被引用实体与演化中的规划之间的交互来修正计划，实现从符号化推理到实际动作的显式路径。

Result: GroundAct在开环测试中于正常、分布外及安全关键场景下均展现出强大规划能力；闭环仿真结果进一步证明其在真实驾驶情境中的有效性，具备良好的鲁棒性与实用性。

Conclusion: 通过将实体作为接地单位并构建从推理到行动的显式路径，GroundAct实现了真正意义上的‘接地规划’，显著提升了驾驶决策的可解释性与可靠性，为复杂场景下的自动驾驶系统提供了有效解决方案。

Abstract: Driving models increasingly ground reasoning in causal relations, spatial structure, perceptual evidence, and predicted futures. These advances make reasoning more faithful to the driving scene, but leave a fundamental question unresolved: what should groundedness mean when the model ultimately outputs an action? Correctly grounded reasoning does not, by itself, ensure desirable driving outcomes. We introduce GroundAct, which starts from a simple premise: driving unfolds through physical entities and their interactions. Entities therefore become the unit of grounding; a lightweight reference token keeps each selected entity's continuous state addressable through symbolic reasoning; and only the referenced entities' interactions with the evolving proposal correct the plan. The result is an explicit path from what reasoning grounds to what the plan does, which we call grounded planning. To assess its practical value, we evaluate GroundAct in both open- and closed-loop settings. GroundAct shows strong open-loop planning across normal, out-of-distribution, and safety-critical scenarios, with closed-loop results extending this evidence to driving in simulation.

</details>


### [265] [A Systematic Investigation of Bias in Large Language Models for Advertising Relevance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07544)
*Weiwei Wang,Yinchuan Xu,Jialu Gao,Youkow Homma,Jian Jiao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究系统评估了大语言模型（LLM）在广告与查询相关性判断中的公平性，发现广告主身份、输入语言及人口统计描述词会影响判断结果，尤其在性别与职业关联上呈现刻板印象。通过GPT-4o和微调的Qwen-7B模型实验，揭示了模型推理与训练阶段的缓解策略效果取决于广告信息是否相关及训练数据分布。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究较少关注大语言模型在广告相关性判断中的公平性问题，而该任务在实际应用中可能因广告主身份、语言或人口描述引发偏见，影响广告投放的公正性。

Method: 采用反事实框架，利用真实广告日志中的查询-广告对以及可控合成的查询，考察广告主身份、语言、人口统计表述等因素对模型判断的影响；对比GPT-4o与训练专用的Qwen-7B模型，并分析推理与训练阶段的缓解策略。

Result: 改变广告主身份或输入语言会显著影响相关性判断；部分人口统计比较显示出与常见刻板印象一致的模式，尤其涉及性别与职业；缓解策略的有效性取决于广告信息是否相关以及训练数据中标签的分布情况。

Conclusion: 大语言模型在广告相关性判断中存在潜在偏见，广告从业者应识别此类公平性风险，并根据具体情境选择合适的缓解方法，以提升系统公正性。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to judge how well an advertisement matches a query, but the fairness of these judgments has received limited attention. We conduct a systematic study of fairness in relevance judgments made by LLMs for queries and advertisements. Our counterfactual framework examines the effects of advertiser identity and possible popularity, input language, and demographic wording. We study GPT-4o as a categorical relevance judge and a Qwen-7B model trained specifically for relevance prediction. The advertiser and language experiments use query and advertisement pairs sampled from real advertising logs. Controlled synthetic queries are used to study demographic associations in employment, housing, and credit. For both models, changing the advertiser identity or input language can alter the relevance assessment. Selected demographic comparisons also show patterns consistent with common stereotypes, particularly those involving gender and occupation. We further study mitigation during model inference and training. The results indicate that its effectiveness depends on whether advertiser information is relevant to the query and how advertiser labels are distributed in the training data. These findings can help advertising practitioners identify fairness risks and develop suitable mitigation methods for LLM relevance systems.

</details>


### [266] [Decoupled Multi-Agent Orchestration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07556)
*Xinle Wu,Yao Lu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: DeOrch 提出一种分离规划与具体工作者选择的两阶段方法，通过无工作者身份的匹配反馈实现条件信用分配，并利用轻量级匹配器在线适应新工作者，无需重新训练。在多种分布内和分布外任务中，DeOrch 在减少工作者调用次数的同时优于现有自动多智能体系统编排方法，且在未见过的工作池上迁移表现良好，两个组件均带来稳定提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法将规划与固定工作池耦合，且从同一终端结果中同时训练任务分解与协作策略，限制了模型的可迁移性并模糊了信用分配。

Method: 提出两阶段规划：第一阶段不依赖工作者信息进行任务分解；第二阶段使用无身份的匹配度反馈选择协作操作，结合轻量级匹配器与上下文带宽算法动态评估和适应工作者适配度。

Result: DeOrch 在多种任务上性能优于现有方法，调用更少的工作者，具备强迁移能力，无需重训即可在全新工作池上有效运行，且分解与协作模块均贡献显著改进。

Conclusion: DeOrch 通过解耦规划与工作者选择，实现了更高效、可迁移、可解释的自动多智能体系统编排，为未来灵活协作系统提供了新范式。

Abstract: Learned orchestration can automatically construct effective language-model multi-agent systems, but existing approaches couple planning to fixed worker pools and train decomposition and collaboration from the same terminal outcome, limiting transfer and obscuring credit assignment. We introduce DeOrch, which separates worker-agnostic planning from concrete worker selection. Its two-stage planner first decomposes the task without worker information, then chooses collaboration operations using compact, worker-identity-free matchability feedback from the pool, enabling conditional credit assignment to decomposition and collaboration decisions. A lightweight matcher estimates worker suitability from behavior on a fixed probe set and adapts online with a contextual bandit, allowing new workers to be incorporated without retraining the planner or matcher. Across diverse in- and out-of-distribution tasks, DeOrch outperforms prior automatic MAS orchestration methods with fewer worker calls than competing learned orchestrators, remains effective when transferred to an entirely unseen worker pool without retraining, and shows consistent gains from both components.

</details>


### [267] [Navigating Route Latent Space for Synthesizable Molecular Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07560)
*Tao Li,Tuan Vinh,Monika Raj,Yuan Fang,Zhichun Guo,Carl Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: RouteFlow提出了一种在连续路线潜在空间中进行可合成分子设计的新框架，通过奖励引导的流匹配实现高效搜索，并引入循环一致性机制保持优化过程在真实合成路径流形上，显著提升了样本效率、合成可及性和逆合成成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法在可合成性感知分子设计中存在两大问题：一是将生成分子投影回可合成类似物会偏离目标；二是直接在离散合成空间中优化缺乏连续搜索空间，导致效率低下。作者认为根本问题在于搜索空间而非优化器本身。

Method: 提出RouteFlow框架，将可合成分子设计转化为在连续路线潜在空间中的搜索，每个潜在变量映射到完整的合成路线，保证可合成性；采用奖励引导的流匹配作为采样器，引导搜索至高属性区域；引入循环一致性机制以防止潜在变量偏离真实合成路径流形，确保解码可靠性。

Result: 在Therapeutic Data Commons的16个优化任务中，RouteFlow在所有可合成性感知基线中表现出最佳的样本效率，同时具有最优的合成可及性与最高的逆合成成功率；循环一致性机制有效维持了优化过程在流形上，且提升了目标属性。

Conclusion: 该研究证明了连续路线潜在空间的有效性，以及循环一致性对稳定优化过程的关键作用，为高效、可合成的分子发现提供了新范式。

Abstract: Goal-directed molecular design has advanced rapidly, yet a substantial proportion of designed molecules remain difficult to synthesize in practice, limiting their real-world utility. Prior synthesizability-aware methods either project generated molecules back to synthesizable analogs that deviate from the intended target, or optimize directly in discrete synthesis spaces that lack a continuous landscape for efficient search. We argue that this limitation mainly comes from the search space rather than the optimizer. To address this, we propose RouteFlow, a framework that reformulates synthesizable molecular design as a search over a continuous route latent space, where each latent maps back to a complete synthesis route and synthesizability is inherently preserved. To navigate this space, we adopt reward-guided flow matching as an efficient sampler that steers toward high-property regions. Since reward optimization may push latents off the manifold of real synthesis routes, where decoding becomes unreliable, we further introduce a cycle-consistency mechanism to stabilize fine-tuning. Across 16 optimization tasks from Therapeutic Data Commons, RouteFlow achieves the best sample efficiency among synthesizability-aware baselines, with the best synthetic accessibility and the highest retrosynthesis success rate. Our results also confirm that the proposed cycle-consistency reliably keeps optimization on-manifold while improving target properties, supporting effective synthesizable molecular discovery.

</details>


### [268] [Unanimously Wrong: Certified Abstention from How Medical LLM Consensus Forms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07570)
*Xiaoyang Wang,Tianrui Wang,Christopher C. Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ProbeGuard 是一种基于共识形成过程的认证弃权框架，通过分析回答生成过程中的轨迹、少数派持续性、检索饱和度等过程特征，以及通过主动探测和理由语义熵来判断一致性是否可靠。该方法在多个医学问答基准上显著提升了对错误一致答案的识别能力，在 MedQA 上使正确与错误共识的区分度达到 0.696 AUROC，且能在 9.0% 的观测选择性风险下正确回答约 60% 的一致答案，随着领域内校准数据积累可提升至 90%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有医疗问答系统依赖多轮共识和答案一致性作为可靠性信号，但一致性可能源于共同误解，无法反映真实正确性；因此需要一种能评估共识形成过程的机制来避免盲目信任一致但错误的答案。

Method: ProbeGuard 采用过程特征分析（如同意轨迹、少数派持续性、检索饱和度）、理由语义熵检测、主动探测反证据，并结合分层学习-测试校准，将过程信号转化为无分布假设的选择性风险上限，实现认证弃权决策。

Result: 在三个医学 QA 基准和一个硬边界参考集上，ProbeGuard 在 MedQA 上成功识别出 13.4% 的错误一致答案，其过程信号将正确与错误共识的区分度从随机水平提升至 0.696 AUROC；认证规则可在 9.0% 观测风险下回答 60% 的一致问题，累积足够校准数据后可扩展至 90%。

Conclusion: 传统以最终一致性为依据的弃权策略存在根本缺陷，而基于共识形成过程的 ProbeGuard 框架能够有效识别虚假一致性，提供可证明的风险控制，显著提升医疗问答系统的可信度与安全性。

Abstract: In clinical practice, agreement among independent experts is treated as evidence of reliability, and multi-round consensus has become a core mechanism of agentic medical question-answering systems. When such a system must decide whether to trust its own answer, the prevailing signal is again agreement, now among the sampled answers. But agreement is a fragile proxy for correctness. A system can be unanimously wrong, returning the same incorrect answer on every sample, and on these questions agreement-based signals carry no information. The cause is that these signals read only the final state of the consensus and discard how it was reached. Agreement that was reached by resolving disagreement with evidence looks identical, at the end, to agreement that was present from the first sample because every sample shares one misconception. ProbeGuard is a certified abstention framework that bases the abstention decision on how the consensus formed. Process features trace agreement trajectories, minority persistence, and retrieval saturation. For unanimous votes, rationale semantic entropy checks whether the reasons behind the vote cohere, and an active probe retrieves counter-evidence and measures whether the consensus survives. A stratified Learn-then-Test calibration then converts these scores into a distribution-free bound on selective risk. We evaluate ProbeGuard on three medical QA benchmarks and a hard-frontier reference, with a published multi-round agentic RAG substrate, against six abstention baselines. On MedQA, 13.4% of unanimous votes are wrong, and no agreement-based signal can flag them. Process signals raise the discrimination of correct from incorrect consensus from chance to 0.696 AUROC. The certified rule answers six in ten unanimous-layer questions at an observed selective risk of 9.0%, and nine in ten once in-domain calibration data accumulate.

</details>


### [269] [Cooperating with Future Collaborators: Multi-Agent RL under Staggered Participation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07578)
*Jianglin Qiao,Siyi Hu,Thien Hoang Nguyen,Zehong Cao,Salah Sukkarieh*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出Staggered Participation Learning (SPL)方法，解决多智能体强化学习中因参与时间不同导致的跨时序、跨智能体学习依赖问题。通过前瞻性信息获取监督和结果监督的接收者学习，在多个环境与算法设置下显著提升任务完成率，平均提升14.1%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在协作多智能体强化学习中，部分智能体先行动并留下对后续智能体有用的信息，形成跨时间、跨智能体的学习依赖。传统方法难以有效处理这种动态信息传递机制，因此需要新的训练策略来识别有用信息并指导后续智能体利用。

Method: 提出Staggered Participation Learning (SPL)，包含两部分：(1) 对早期智能体采用前瞻性获取监督，鼓励其生成对未来决策有价值的信息；(2) 对后期智能体采用结果监督的接收学习，使其学会有效利用前序智能体提供的信息。

Result: 在60个MPE/RWARE基准设置中，SPL在所有情况下均取得更高平均任务完成率，平均提升14.1%；在八智能体团队及Isaac Lab中的无人机-无人车物理仿真环境中也表现出色，验证了方法在算法、时间与具身场景下的泛化能力。

Conclusion: SPL能够有效应对多智能体系统中因参与顺序差异带来的学习挑战，通过设计合理的训练机制，实现信息的有效生成与利用，显著提升协作性能，具有广泛适用性。

Abstract: In cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL), agents are often trained under concurrent participation, while in many tasks some agents act earlier and leave task-relevant information that becomes useful to agents participating later. We study this setting as staggered participation (SP), which introduces a cross-time, cross-agent learning dependency because an early action may affect the return through the information it provides and the later policy that uses it. Learning under SP therefore requires both identifying what information is useful for future decisions and learning how later agents should use it. We propose Staggered Participation Learning (SPL), a training-time augmentation that addresses these two parts with prospective acquisition supervision for earlier agents and outcome-supervised receiver learning for later agents. We evaluate SPL across multiple policy-based MARL backbones, environments, and staggered-participation patterns. Across 60 MPE/RWARE backbone setting comparisons, SPL achieves higher observed mean task completion in every case, with an average difference of 14.1%. The gains also extend to eight-agent teams and a physics-based UAV-UGV environment in Isaac Lab, providing evidence across algorithmic, temporal, and embodied settings.

</details>


### [270] [LOGIC: An LLM Benchmark for Intent-Grounded Change Impact in Aerospace Electrical Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07580)
*Muhammad Faraz Shoaib,Muhammad Qasim,Raisulhaq Mohammed Rizwan,Rahmatullah Safdar,Muzammil Adnan Shaik,Abdul Aleem Mohammed*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: LOGIC是一个用于评估航天电气设计变更中候选变更选择与传播的基准框架，利用本地部署的语言模型结合结构化证据进行确定性候选变更筛选，并通过类型化的电气可追溯图进行影响传播。该框架包含168个场景，涵盖144个选择和24个放弃案例。实验表明，在明确锚定的选择任务中，仅使用门控结构证据的F1得分为1.0000，优于词法匹配的0.9677；而在关系性改写任务中，语言模型表现更优（F1 0.5000–0.6400），而词法方法几乎无效（F1 0.1772）。随着候选库增大，模型的判断能力下降，但下游传播准确性保持稳定。严格证据门控虽能抑制误报，但可能遗漏正确语义选择；探索性空证据弃权策略提升了弃权准确率至0.6667，降低不安全报告率至0.1667，但覆盖度下降16.0–27.1个百分点。六组冲突请求中四组仍对所有模型存在安全隐患。研究建议在意图无法可靠确定时，应结合字面证据、语言模型推理与工程评审。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 航空航天电气设计修订中，工程请求常授权部分变更，但系统检测到多个差异，若全部传播会导致影响报告过宽。因此需要一种能精准识别真实变更并控制传播范围的方法，以避免误报和冗余分析。

Method: 提出LOGIC框架，采用本地部署语言模型将工程请求与确定性的候选变更清单对齐，基于结构化证据进行候选选择，再通过类型化电气可追溯图实现选定变更的下游影响传播。区分候选选择错误与下游传播错误，支持误差归因。

Result: 在96个显式锚定的选择任务中，门控结构证据的候选选择F1达1.0000，优于词法匹配的0.9677；在12个关系性改写任务中，语言模型性能显著优于词法方法（F1 0.5000–0.6400 vs. 0.1772）。当候选库从4增至64时，模型判断能力下降，但下游传播精度稳定。严格证据门控提升精确性但牺牲召回；空证据弃权策略提高弃权准确率至0.6667，降低不安全报告率至0.1667，但覆盖度下降16.0–27.1个百分点。四个冲突请求仍对所有模型构成安全风险。

Conclusion: 在意图不可靠时，应结合字面证据、语言模型推理与人工工程评审，以确保变更选择的准确性和影响传播的安全性。

Abstract: Aerospace electrical-design revisions can contain multiple genuine changes, although an engineering request may authorize only a subset. Propagating every detected difference can therefore produce overly broad impact reports. We present LOGIC, a controlled benchmark and evaluation framework in which locally deployable language models ground a request in a deterministic candidate-change inventory before selected changes are propagated through a typed electrical traceability graph. This separation permits candidate-selection errors to be distinguished from downstream propagation errors. LOGIC contains 168 scenarios, including 144 selection and 24 abstention cases. We evaluate three 7--8B models against intent-agnostic, lexical, and structured-evidence methods, with an oracle-root upper bound. On 96 explicitly anchored selection cases, gate-only structured evidence achieves candidate F1 of 1.0000, compared with 0.9677 for token-lexical matching. On 12 relational-paraphrase cases, token-lexical F1 is 0.1772 and gate-only F1 is 0.0000, compared with 0.5000--0.6400 for the large language models. Model grounding degrades as candidate inventories grow from 4 to 64 changes, while affected-element and typed-path accuracy remain comparatively stable when frozen selections are replayed over graphs of approximately 1K to 100K nodes. Strict evidence gating suppresses false positives but can remove correct semantic selections. An exploratory evidence-empty abstention policy raises strict abstention accuracy to 0.6667 for all three models and reduces unsafe-report rates to 0.1667, while decreasing answerable-case coverage by 16.0--27.1 percentage points. Four of six conflicting requests remain unsafe for each model. These findings support combining literal evidence and language-model reasoning with engineering review when intent cannot be established reliably.

</details>


### [271] [Representation Bias, Correction Transfer, and Resolution Sensitivity in Three-Dimensional Mitochondrial Morphometry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07582)
*Farouk Ganiyu Adewumi,Timothy Oladunni*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究评估了三维线粒体形态测量的实证可靠性，揭示了不同图像处理管道导致的系统性偏差。通过2,720个来自3D线粒体形状库的发育对象，发现基于占据的体积比参考网格体积平均高3.665%，且存在0.00304标准化单位的标签向外偏移。在控制条件下重实现标签-流程后，去除深度偏移使所有55个对象的体积误差平均减少1.57个百分点（约45%的再现膨胀）。使用冻结回归模型，将2,728个新对象的中位绝对百分比误差从3.481%降至0.664%，但其校准误差范围仅覆盖92.1%总体和49.2%低占据子组，表明准确性和不确定性传递需分别评估。在550个大鼠皮层对象中，平面分辨率从8纳米粗化至24纳米时，中位表面面积下降10.60%，球形度上升11.76%，尽管等级相关性仍高达0.994。结果为区分处理引起的描述符变化与潜在生物学差异提供了量化检验，但未建立生物学不变性或跨源校正转移的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开发可靠的三维线粒体形态测量方法，以识别和量化图像处理流程引入的系统性偏差，从而区分真实生物学差异与技术误差。

Method: 利用3D线粒体形状库和MitoEM资源中的大量样本，结合边界分析、控制实验、标签-流程重实现、冻结回归建模及分辨率敏感性测试，系统评估形态测量中的表示偏差、处理干预效果与误差传递特性。

Result: 占据体积平均高3.665%，标签存在0.00304单位的向外偏移；去除深度偏移可减少约45%的体积误差；冻结回归显著降低误差（中位绝对百分比误差从3.481%降至0.664%），但校准覆盖不完全；分辨率粗化导致表面面积和球形度显著变化，尽管排名相关性高。

Conclusion: 图像处理流程会引入显著的系统性偏差，必须通过量化手段加以识别和校正。准确性与不确定性传递应独立评估，当前方法尚无法保证跨数据源的可靠校正转移。研究结果为区分技术误差与生物学差异提供了重要工具。

Abstract: Quantitative imaging pipelines can produce precise but systematically different measurements of the same object. We present an empirical reliability assessment of three-dimensional mitochondrial morphometry that connects representation bias, a controlled processing intervention, correction transfer, and resolution sensitivity. Using 2,720 development objects from the 3D Mitochondria Shape Library for Optical Microscopy, we find that occupancy-derived volumes exceed reference mesh volumes by 3.665% on average despite an intraclass correlation coefficient of 0.994. Boundary analysis identifies an outward label displacement of 0.00304 normalized units. In a controlled label-pipeline reimplementation, removing the depth offset reduces volume error in all 55 analyzed objects by a mean of 1.57 percentage points, approximately 45% of mean reproduced inflation; the source of the remainder is not isolated. A frozen regression using occupancy-derived features reduces median absolute percentage error from 3.481% to 0.664% in 2,728 previously unused objects from the same resource. However, its calibrated error bound covers only 92.1% overall and 49.2% in a low-occupancy subgroup, demonstrating that accuracy and uncertainty transfer must be evaluated separately. In 550 rat-cortex objects from the MitoEM resource, coarsening in-plane spacing from 8 to 24 nanometers changes median surface area by minus 10.60% and sphericity by plus 11.76%, despite a rank correlation of 0.994. These results provide quantitative checks for distinguishing processing-induced descriptor changes from candidate biological differences, without establishing biological invariance or cross-source correction transfer.

</details>


### [272] [Personal-Agent Mediated Recommendation with Cross-Platform User History](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07588)
*Yu Xia,Jiangfan Zhang,Jun Xiao,Julian McAuley,Xiangjun Fan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出个人代理中介推荐（Personal-Agent Mediated Recommendation）新范式，其中平台推荐器基于本地信息生成候选集，个人代理则利用用户授权的跨平台历史对结果进行中介调整。为解决平台排名与个人偏好间的权衡问题，作者构建了MediateRec基准测试平台，并提出个人归因中介优化（PAMO）方法，通过反事实掩码估计个人中介支持度，重新分配排序感知优势质量。理论证明PAMO在保持截断级优势质量的前提下达到局部最优。实验表明，尽管强基线大模型仍存在有害覆盖，但PAMO显著优于仅基于结果的强化学习方法，在多个平台和真实跨平台测试中均实现更优的修正-伤害平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统推荐系统以平台为中心，缺乏用户对自身数据的控制权；随着个人大模型代理的发展，用户需要能自主协调跨平台行为的推荐机制，因此亟需一种能够有效融合平台群体证据与个人历史的中介推荐框架。

Method: 提出MediateRec基准，包含可扩展的代理跨平台环境与真实跨平台测试；设计PAMO方法，通过反事实掩码模拟缺失历史，估计个人中介支持力，并在平台相对价值下限约束下重分配排序优势质量。

Result: PAMO在多个平台和真实跨平台测试中表现优异，相比结果导向的强化学习方法提升明显，同时更好地平衡了有益修正与有害覆盖之间的关系；即使强大预训练模型也存在非可忽略的有害干预现象。

Conclusion: 个人代理中介推荐是未来个性化推荐的重要方向；PAMO方法有效解决了跨平台信息整合中的关键权衡问题，为用户主导的个性化推荐提供了可靠技术路径。

Abstract: Modern recommendation is shifting from platform-centric personalization toward user-governed personalization, where a personal LLM agent can act on the user's behalf across services. We formalize this emerging paradigm as Personal-Agent Mediated Recommendation: a platform recommender ranks a candidate set using platform-local information, and a personal agent uses user-authorized cross-platform history to mediate the resulting ranking and produce the final top-K slate. Such mediation is nontrivial: the platform ranking can encode strong population evidence that the personal agent cannot observe, so effective mediation must therefore balance beneficial rescues against harmful overrides. To study this trade-off, we introduce MediateRec, a benchmark that includes scalable proxy cross-platform environments and a real cross-platform test under a controlled platform-agent information boundary. To train the agent to use cross-platform history effectively, we further propose Personal Attribution Mediation Optimization (PAMO), which counterfactually masks that history to estimate personal mediation support and reallocates rank-aware advantage mass under a platform-relative value floor. We theoretically prove that PAMO preserves cutoff-level advantage mass and is locally optimal among first-order reallocations that preserve this mass without lowering average platform-relative value. Experiments on MediateRec show that personal-agent mediation enables meaningful platform corrections, yet even strong proprietary LLMs introduce non-negligible harmful overrides. PAMO consistently improves over matched outcome-only RL across seen and unseen target platforms and on the real cross-platform test, while achieving a better rescue-harm balance.

</details>


### [273] [LSC-DPO: Learning-Signal-Controlled Direct Preference Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07592)
*Yang Qu,Yusheng Han,Chengjia Feng,Handan Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: LSC-DPO提出一种动态调节学习信号的新方法，通过几何视角分析DPO的敏感性问题，利用对数空间分析实现稳定跟踪目标学习信号，并通过信号预算补偿规则减少初始化差异带来的性能波动，在多个基准测试中优于DPO及现有强基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DPO在训练过程中因偏好边际扩大导致逻辑损失敏感性下降，影响模型优化效果，亟需提升损失函数对学习信号的响应能力。

Method: 从损失层面的几何视角出发，识别出sigmoid因子作为局部敏感性的学习信号；提出LSC-DPO，动态调节学习信号至目标区间；引入对数空间分析确保稳定性；设计信号预算补偿规则以应对不同初始化引起的瞬态轨迹差异。

Result: LSC-DPO在AlpacaEval 2、MT-Bench和Anthropic-HH上均显著优于DPO及其它先进方法；信号预算补偿有效降低因初始化不同导致的性能波动。

Conclusion: LSC-DPO通过可控学习信号机制提升了模型对偏好数据的响应能力，增强了训练稳定性与鲁棒性，为无奖励模型对齐提供了新范式。

Abstract: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) has become a standard reward-model-free approach for aligning language models with preference data. However, as the scaled preference margin grows during training, the logistic DPO loss becomes progressively less sensitive to further changes. We study DPO from a loss-level geometric perspective and identify the sigmoid factor as a learning signal that characterizes the local sensitivity of the objective. Based on this view, we propose Learning-Signal-Controlled Direct Preference Optimization (LSC-DPO), which dynamically regulates the learning signal near a target regime. A log-space analysis establishes conditions for stable tracking of the target learning-signal regime. Experiments on AlpacaEval 2, MT-Bench, and Anthropic-HH show that LSC-DPO consistently improves over DPO and strong preference-optimization baselines. We further find that different coefficient initializations induce distinct transient learning-signal trajectories even when their later signal levels become similar. Based on this observation, we derive a signal-budget compensation rule that adjusts the target learning signal to compensate for these transient differences. The resulting compensation substantially reduces performance variation across coefficient initializations.

</details>


### [274] [Beyond Scalar IoU: Structured Verification from Rollout Groups for Video Temporal Grounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07601)
*Youngjae Cho,Won Young Jhoo,Jongsuk Kim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SUTURE introduces a novel reinforcement learning framework for video temporal grounding by leveraging the joint structure of rollout groups. It improves verification by considering both disagreement among rollouts and coverage at each time position, leading to better reward distribution and performance across benchmarks.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Existing overlap verifiers in reinforcement learning for video temporal grounding score rollouts independently, ignoring the collective structure of rollout groups, which limits their effectiveness in guiding policy learning.

Method: SUTURE conditions verification on the entire rollout group, using disagreement across rollouts to reweight targets and coverage at each position to redistribute reward mass. This results in an exact decomposition of the verifier into standard IoU and a covariance correction term based on group structure.

Result: SUTURE achieves superior performance across five temporal grounding benchmarks at all IoU thresholds. It also reduces video-start anchoring, with earlier mentions more accurately aligning with target intervals for later events.

Conclusion: Exploiting the joint structure of rollout groups enables a more informative and effective temporal verifier, improving both accuracy and reasoning quality in video grounding tasks.

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) provides a natural framework for adapting pretrained models to video temporal grounding, where generated temporal intervals can be scored directly against ground truth intervals. Yet existing overlap verifiers typically score each rollout independently, leaving the joint structure of the rollout group unused. We introduce SUTURE, which conditions verification on the rollout group and exploits its structure at two complementary scales: disagreement across rollouts controls how strongly the target is reweighted, while coverage at each position determines where reward mass is redistributed. We show that the resulting verifier admits an exact decomposition into the standard IoU term and a covariance correction determined by the rollout group. A local gradient diagnostic finds a preference for responses covering relatively less supported target regions in the analyzed groups. Across five temporal grounding benchmarks, SUTURE improves grounding performance at every reported IoU threshold. Its trained policy also shows less video-start anchoring in reasoning traces: for later events, the first temporal mention more often overlaps the annotated target. Together, these results show that the joint structure of a rollout group can support a more informative temporal verifier.

</details>


### [275] [VALSE: Vertical Adaptive Layer Skipping for Efficient Inference in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07606)
*Jia-Dong Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文建立了垂直自适应层跳过（VALSE）的理论框架，证明了三个基础结论：(i) 期望计算量公式（定理2），给出了任意逐样本跳过策略的计算成本闭式表达；(ii) 函数空间的超集与严格包含关系（定理10和11），表明跳层模型严格包含于全层函数空间，但能有意义地逼近，并给出明确的分离示例；(iii) VALSE与专家混合（MoE）架构之间的结构对偶性（命题6），将垂直深度稀疏性定位为水平宽度稀疏性的正交补充。基于该理论，提出VALSE方法，通过轻量级难度估计器在前几层评估输入，再由逐层门控选择性跳过冗余层（包括任意中间层，保留深层），仅激活每个输入所需的最小深度，其可行性已在原型规模上初步验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为了实现深度神经网络中更高效的计算，特别是针对不同输入的自适应计算需求，提出一种能够动态跳过冗余层的机制，以减少不必要的计算开销，同时保持模型表达能力。

Method: 提出VALSE方法，利用轻量级难度估计器评估输入复杂度，结合逐层门控机制，实现非连续、逐样本的层跳过，允许跳过任意中间层而保留深层，从而仅激活必要深度。

Result: 建立了理论框架并验证了三层核心结论，证明了计算成本可精确建模，跳层模型虽受限但仍能有效逼近完整函数空间，且与MoE存在结构对偶性；初步实验表明，所提方法在原型规模下具备可行性。

Conclusion: VALSE通过理论支撑与创新设计，实现了按需激活网络深度，显著提升计算效率，同时保持模型性能，为高效神经网络设计提供了新范式。

Abstract: This paper establishes a theoretical framework for vertical adaptive layer skipping, proving three foundational results: (i) an Expected FLOPs formula (theorem 2) giving a closed-form expression for the computational cost of arbitrary per-sample skip schedules as a function of layer-wise skip probabilities; (ii) function-space superset (theorem 10) and strict inclusion (theorem 11) theorems showing that skip-layer models are strictly contained in---yet meaningfully approximate---the full-layer function space, with an explicit separating example; and (iii) a structural duality between VALSE and Mixture-of-Experts architectures (proposition 6), positioning vertical depth-wise sparsity as the orthogonal counterpart to horizontal width-wise sparsity. Building on this theory, we propose VALSE (Vertical Adaptive Layer Skipping for Efficiency), a per-sample, non-contiguous layer skipping method: a lightweight difficulty estimator scores each input from the first few layers, and per-layer gates selectively skip redundant layers---including arbitrary middle layers while retaining deeper ones---so that only the necessary depth is activated for each input, whose feasibility is preliminarily assessed at prototype scale.

</details>


### [276] [BioStudyBench: Evaluating Agents on Post-Cutoff Biomedical Studies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07614)
*David Li,Shaamil Karim,Christian Gensbigler*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究提出BioStudyBench基准，评估AI代理在无先验知识情况下复现已发表生物医学研究的能力。通过25个长期分析任务，测试模型在仅使用公开数据和工具时的表现，结果显示引入数据与工具后平均通过率提升47个百分点；闭源模型表现优于开源模型，最佳闭源模型通过率为94.7%，最佳开源模型为81.3%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有评估方法未能有效区分分析过程与已有知识或答案检索，导致结果不可靠。为更真实地衡量AI在生物医学研究中的分析能力，需构建一个能隔离先验知识、依赖真实数据获取与分析的基准。

Method: 构建BioStudyBench基准，从2026年7月至9月间发表的404,019条PubMed记录中筛选出25个长周期分析任务，确保这些研究在模型知识截止日期之后发表。每个任务中，代理仅接收中立的研究问题，无法直接访问数据文件，必须自主查找并下载公共数据，利用仅返回截止日期前文献的工具进行检索，并通过数据分析报告结果。通过对比有无数据与工具条件下的表现，评估模型的实际分析能力。

Result: 在八个模型中，引入数据和工具后，平均通过率较无数据基线提高47个百分点。闭源模型整体表现优于开源模型，最佳闭源模型通过率为94.7%，最佳开源模型通过率为81.3%。

Conclusion: AI代理在具备数据获取与分析能力的前提下，可显著提升对生物医学研究结论的复现能力，但当前性能仍受模型权重开放性影响，开源模型仍有较大提升空间。该研究验证了构建去偏倚、真实世界评估基准的重要性。

Abstract: We evaluate whether AI agents can match the reported findings of published biomedical studies using public data. Existing evaluations do not consistently separate analysis from prior knowledge or retrieval of the published answer. We introduce BioStudyBench, a benchmark of 25 long-horizon analysis tasks drawn from studies first published between July and September 2026, after the developer-reported knowledge cutoffs of the models we evaluate, semi-automatically filtered down from 404,019 PubMed records. In each task, the agent receives a neutral research question but no data files, so it must find and download the relevant public data, search the literature through tools that return only records dated before its cutoff, and report findings through data analysis. To measure gains over prior knowledge, we run every task both with and without access to data and tools. Across eight models, access to data and tools raises the pass rate by 47 percentage points on average over the no-data baseline. Open-weight models across sizes trail closed-weight models, with the best open-weight model passing 81.3% of tasks against 94.7% for the best closed-weight model.

</details>


### [277] [Explore, Then Commit: Measurement-Efficient Scientific Law Discovery with Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07620)
*Kautik Mandve,Dileepa Fernando*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究评估了一种探索-然后承诺的协议，利用大语言模型提出假设，程序化规划器收集测量数据，并通过新提示从固定观测中合成最终定律。该协议结合了结构化探测、自动数值诊断、受限测量批次和可选解释器访问。在576次NewtonBench实验中，对比了八种配置在12个物理模块上的表现，使用GPT-4.1-mini和中等难度的GPT-4.1复现版本。在中等任务上，启用解释器的规划器分别使用8.6和8.9次测量（相比无解释器的22.5和43.0次），其基于量级的均方对数误差从2.514降至0.202（GPT-4.1-mini）和从0.626降至0.149（GPT-4.1）。额外审计保留不完整和无效提交以进行覆盖敏感分析。符号准确性提升在各模块间不一致，随机采集与分歧评分表现相当。所有模块中均实现测量节省，但不均衡的批次约束使无法仅归因于采集质量。结果支持该完整协议作为有前景的高效测量配置，但其因果成分及在非噪声直接方程任务中的泛化能力仍待澄清。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学定律发现需要选择测量并把证据转化为控制方程。传统方法在测量效率和自动化方面存在局限，亟需一种更高效的系统性框架来提升科学发现过程的自动化水平。

Method: 采用探索-然后承诺协议：大语言模型生成假设；程序化规划器根据需求获取测量数据；新提示将固定观测值整合为最终定律。引入结构化探测、自动数值诊断、受限测量批次及可选解释器访问，形成多阶段协作机制。在多个物理模块上测试不同配置，使用GPT-4.1-mini与中等难度的GPT-4.1复现版本进行验证。

Result: 在中等任务上，启用解释器的规划器显著减少测量次数（如8.6 vs 22.5次/试验），同时大幅降低误差（如2.514降至0.202）。符号准确性提升在不同模块间不一致，随机采集策略与分歧评分表现相当。所有模块均实现测量节省，但因批次约束不均，难以单独归因于采集质量。整体表明该协议具有测量效率优势，但其核心机制和泛化能力尚不明确。

Conclusion: 该完整的探索-然后承诺协议展现出显著的测量效率优势，是一种有前景的科学定律发现配置。然而，其内部因果机制以及在非理想条件下的泛化能力仍需进一步研究。

Abstract: Scientific law discovery requires selecting measurements and converting evidence into a governing equation. We evaluate an explore-then-commit protocol in which a large language model proposes hypotheses, a programmatic planner gathers measurements, and a fresh prompt synthesizes the final law from fixed observations. The protocol combines structured probes, automatic numerical diagnostics, restricted measurement batches, and optional interpreter access. Across 576 NewtonBench trials, we compare eight configurations on 12 physics modules using GPT-4.1-mini and a medium-difficulty GPT-4.1 replication. On medium tasks, interpreter-enabled planners use 8.6 versus 22.5 measurements per trial for GPT-4.1-mini and 8.9 versus 43.0 for GPT-4.1. Their mean magnitude-based root-mean-squared logarithmic error falls from 2.514 to 0.202 and from 0.626 to 0.149, respectively. An additional audit retains incomplete and invalid submissions in a coverage-sensitive analysis. Observed symbolic-accuracy gains are less consistent across modules, and random acquisition is competitive with disagreement scoring. Measurement savings occur in every module, but unequal batch constraints prevent attributing them solely to acquisition quality. These results support the complete protocol as a promising measurement-efficient configuration, while leaving its causal components and generalization beyond noiseless direct-equation tasks unresolved.

</details>


### [278] [Learning to Outgrow a Theory: Experimental Discovery Beyond the Initial Hypothesis Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07627)
*SiYuan Ma,Albert Gao,Chunzheng Zhu,Xin Yan,Wenlong Zhang,Wenxin Zhang,Luqi Gong,Tianlin Li,Qixin Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种实验模型类修订方法，通过联合提议结构编辑和诊断实验来解决传统科学发现系统在固定假设空间下的缺陷。该方法利用类级可区分性目标与任意时间有效的序列证据，仅在当前模型类被拒绝后才触发结构修订。在400个受控动态环境中，该方法以32次真实实验预算实现了89.5%的精确恢复，优于最强基线10个百分点，且实验次数更少。模型还能跨未见机制组合、未见可表达原语、参数外推及成本变化迁移，并在真实机制超出编辑语法时以88%准确率检测到知识库不足，误支持率仅为5.5%。该方法在ODEBench、ODEBase及DiscoverPhysics任务中也表现出良好泛化能力，表明理论机制表达范围的选择与证据收集应作为统一的序贯决策问题处理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有科学发现系统通常在固定假设空间内优化实验，当所有候选模型均遗漏同一关键机制时，会导致候选分歧崩溃，即使模型类别系统性错误也无法察觉。为克服此局限，本文提出将模型类的结构修订纳入发现策略中，使系统能主动识别并修正模型类的结构性缺陷。

Method: 提出一种联合策略，同时生成结构编辑建议和诊断实验，用于测试该编辑是否必要。采用类级可区分性目标（一个共享参数化需解释所有选定实验），结合任意时间有效的序列证据，仅在当前模型类被充分否定后才触发结构修订。

Result: 在400个受控动态环境上，该方法以32次实验达到89.5%的精确恢复率，比最强基线提升10个百分点，且执行实验更少；在多种迁移场景下表现稳健，包括未见机制组合、参数外推、成本变化等；当真实机制超出编辑语法时，能以88%准确率检测出库不足，误支持率仅5.5%。该方法在多个基准任务和物理发现世界中均实现显著性能提升。

Conclusion: 科学发现应将决定理论应包含哪些机制以及何处收集证据视为一个统一的序贯决策过程。通过联合优化模型类修订与实验设计，系统能够更有效地识别并修正结构性错误，提升发现效率与鲁棒性。

Abstract: Scientific discovery systems typically optimize experiments within a fixed hypothesis space. This creates a failure mode when all available candidates omit the same missing mechanism: candidate disagreement can collapse even while the model class is systematically wrong. We formulate experimental model-class revision, in which a discovery policy jointly proposes a structural edit and a diagnostic experiment that tests whether that edit is necessary. The method couples a class-level distinguishability objective, in which one shared parameterization must explain all selected experiments, with anytime-valid sequential evidence that triggers structural revision only after the current class is rejected. On 400 held-out controlled dynamical environments, the joint policy reaches 89.5% exact recovery with a budget of 32 real experiments, improving the strongest matched baseline by 10.0 percentage points while requiring fewer executed experiments and candidate fits. The learned revision-experiment pairing transfers across unseen mechanism combinations, held-out but expressible primitives, parameter extrapolation, and shifted experiment costs; when the true mechanism is outside the edit grammar, it detects library insufficiency in 88% of cases with a 5.5% false-support rate. Revision gains also transfer to ODEBench and ODEBase model-library tasks, as well as DiscoverPhysics worlds. These results support a view of scientific discovery in which deciding what mechanisms a theory should make expressible and where to collect evidence are treated as a single sequential decision problem.

</details>


### [279] [Measuring climate backlash in Twitter and Reddit archives: Lexical definitions, recorded responses and participant turnover](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07634)
*Wentao Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究分析了四个社交媒体档案（Twitter和Reddit），通过非抽样、透明且非排他的词汇规则处理所有数据，揭示了词语、回应计数和参与者观测值并不衡量同一社会过程。研究发现，可再生能源术语常与成本相关语言共现于Reddit，但更狭窄的反对性表达显著降低跨平台对比，并逆转巴黎协定相关对比符号。跨话语历史无法提升主要情境预测。否认/骗局类词汇与更高的推文点赞数相关，而Reddit的回应关联则取决于框架、结果和作者指定。2019年全球气候罢课期间，回流作者表达与参与者更替共同推动抗议语言占比上升。档案端点阻止了相应气候推特迁移推论。大多数跨集群估计缺乏发布区间，联合作者/月份回应协方差估计失败，限制正式推断。研究强调操作定义、平台特定回应字段和观察边界如何塑造对气候抵制的结论，贡献在于提供基于档案的测量后果分析，而非个体反对、说服或倡导引发的抵制度量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 社交媒体档案常被用于研究对气候行动的抵制，但现有方法中词语、回应计数和参与者观测值并未统一衡量同一社会过程，导致误解风险。本文旨在澄清这些测量差异，揭示平台特性与操作定义如何影响对气候抵制的解释。

Method: 对四个提供的Twitter和Reddit档案进行全量处理，不采样；应用透明、非排他性的词汇规则；结合框架共现与源特定的时间及响应模型；分离回流作者事件期变化与参与者更替的影响；使用统计模型评估跨平台对比、响应关联与预测能力。

Result: 可再生能源术语在Reddit中与成本语言共现，但狭窄的反对性短语削弱跨源对比并反转巴黎协定相关对比符号；跨话语历史不能改善主情境预测；否认/骗局词与更高推文点赞相关，而Reddit响应依赖于框架、结果和作者；2019年气候罢课期间，回流作者表达与参与者更替共同增加抗议语言比例；档案端点阻碍气候推特迁移推论；多数跨集群估计无发布区间，联合协方差估计失败，限制正式推断。

Conclusion: 操作定义、平台特定响应字段和观察边界深刻影响对气候抵制的结论。本研究提供的是基于档案的测量后果分析，而非个体层面的反对、说服或倡导引发的抵制度量。

Abstract: Social media archives are often used to study resistance to climate action, but words, response counters and observed participants do not measure the same social process. We examine four supplied Twitter and Reddit archives by processing all registered files without sampling and applying transparent, non-exclusive lexical rules. The study links frame co-occurrence to source-specific temporal and response models, then separates event-period changes among returning authors from participant turnover. Renewable-energy terms accompany cost-related language on Reddit, yet narrower backlash phrases sharply reduce cross-source contrasts and reverse the sign of the Paris Agreement contrast in submissions. Cross-discourse history does not improve eligible primary-context forecasts. Denial/hoax terms are associated with higher recorded Twitter likes, whereas Reddit response associations depend on frame, outcome and author specification. Around the 2019 global climate strike, returning-author expression and participant turnover both contribute to increased protest-language shares. An archive endpoint prevents the corresponding Climate Twitter migration inference. Most crossed-cluster estimates lack released intervals, and joint author/month response covariance estimates fail, restricting formal inference. These results show how operational definitions, platform-specific response fields and observation boundaries shape what can be claimed about climate backlash. The contribution is an archive-based account of these measurement consequences, rather than a measure of individual opposition, persuasion or advocacy-induced backlash.

</details>


### [280] [Learning Explainable Representations of Complex Game-playing Strategies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07638)
*Abhijeet Krishnan,Colin M. Potts,Arnav Jhala,Harshad Khadilkar,Shirish Karande,Chris Martens*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种类人认知的策略，用于训练强化学习代理从游戏行为序列中自动学习可执行的策略程序，以在国际象棋和网格环境任务中有效决策。该方法通过分析玩家行为数据提取抽象策略，提升智能体的性能与解释能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类玩家在复杂游戏中会发展出符合规则的概念和策略抽象，以提升表现并理解他人行为。然而，理解对手策略耗时费力，因此需要自动化方法来辅助智能体学习此类策略。

Method: 基于游戏行为序列，设计方法自动学习可执行的策略程序，将策略和策略映射为可执行的程序，应用于国际象棋和网格环境任务。

Result: 所学策略能够生成有效动作，并且可以从实际游戏数据中成功学习，显著提升了智能体的表现和可解释性。

Conclusion: 本研究验证了类人策略学习方法的有效性，表明智能体可以通过学习游戏行为数据中的抽象策略，实现更高效、可解释的游戏决策。

Abstract: As part of learning to play complex games, human players develop develop abstractions for concepts and strategies of gameplay consistent with game rules to improve their performance. These concepts are applied to explain other players' actions, and to inform their own actions in-game. Understanding other players' strategies is a crucial part of such improvement, but requires time and effort. In this paper, we propose a strategy similar to human cognition for training RL agents to synthesize learned strategies and policies as executable procedures based on sequences of gameplay actions. We present methods to automatically learn such programs to play chess and to solve tasks in a grid-based environment. We show that the learned strategies produce effective actions, and can be learned from gameplay data.

</details>


### [281] [Towards the Automatic Synthesis of Interpretable Chess Tactics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07640)
*Abhijeet Krishnan,Chris Martens*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于符号子策略的国际象棋强化学习模型，利用归纳逻辑编程（PAL）学习的模式，结合国际象棋战术知识以提升可解释性。通过引入发散度度量评估模型性能，并验证其生成的战术能与人类初学者水平相当。最后，通过将该模型集成到现成引擎中进行计算评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有强化学习代理在国际象棋等游戏中超越人类专家，但其决策过程缺乏可解释性。理解这些策略有助于提升人类玩家的水平，因此需要一种融合领域知识、提高可解释性的模型。

Method: 基于归纳逻辑编程（PAL）学习的模式，构建符号子策略模型，结合国际象棋战术知识；设计发散度度量评估模型相对于随机基线的表现；将模型集成至现成国际象棋引擎中进行计算评估。

Result: 所提出的模型能够生成与人类初学者水平相当的走法，且通过发散度度量验证了其有效性；计算评估表明模型在增强引擎表现方面具有潜力。

Conclusion: 本工作为国际象棋强化学习提供了更具可解释性的符号化建模方法，未来可进一步优化并应用于人类棋手的策略学习。

Abstract: State-of-the-art reinforcement learning agents are capable of outperforming human experts at games like chess, Go and StarCraft II. These agents do not simply take advantage of their digital hardware in being able to react and calculate faster than humans, but employ better strategies that lead to more victories. Interpreting these strategies would give human players valuable insight into how to improve their play. In this preliminary work, we propose a symbolic sub-policy model for playing chess. Inspired by chess tactics, our model attempts to incorporate domain knowledge to improve interpretability. We adapt patterns learned by an inductive logic programming system called PAL to derive our model. We contribute a divergence metric to evaluate our model against a random baseline, and find a set of tactics that is able to suggest moves of similar playing strength to a human beginner. Finally, we propose a computational evaluation scheme for the model by augmenting an off-the-shelf engine with it.

</details>


### [282] [Matching Object or Relation? Tracing Abstract Reasoning Inside VLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07646)
*Gouki Minegishi,Hiroki Furuta,Takeshi Kojima,Yusuke Iwasawa,Yutaka Matsuo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究通过借鉴心理学中的关系匹配样本（RMTS）范式，结合对模型内部机制的分析，揭示了视觉语言模型（VLMs）在抽象推理任务中失败的原因。研究发现，模型规模、场景中物体数量、刺激噪声存在与否以及能力层级是影响其向关系匹配能力发展的四个关键因素，并呈现出类似人类认知发展的轨迹。进一步的层间表征相似性与因果中介分析表明，VLMs 的抽象推理由两个竞争性回路实现：早期回路基于表面物体特征组织图像，晚期回路则基于抽象关系进行组织。在 ARC-AGI-1 上的消融实验也证实，移除在 RMTS 中识别出的关系头会显著降低性能，说明该关系回路在更广泛任务中被实际使用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准无法解释 VLMs 在抽象推理任务中系统性失败的根本原因，缺乏对缺失认知能力的机制理解。本研究旨在填补这一空白，从心理学启发的范式出发，探究 VLMs 抽象推理能力的内在实现机制。

Method: 采用关系匹配样本（RMTS）范式设计参数化可控的刺激集，评估多个前沿 API 模型（GPT、Claude、Gemini）和开源模型（Qwen3.5、Gemma-4、InternVL3）。通过层间表征相似性分析（RSA）和因果中介分析，解析模型内部表示动态；并在 ARC-AGI-1 上进行头部消融实验验证关系回路的泛化能力。

Result: 识别出四个关键调控因子（模型规模、物体数量、噪声、能力层级），推动 VLMs 向关系匹配发展；发现存在两个竞争性回路：早期基于表面特征，晚期基于抽象关系；在 ARC-AGI-1 上，移除关系头导致性能下降显著高于随机头，证明该回路具有跨任务泛化能力。

Conclusion: 该研究提供了机制层面的理解，揭示了 VLMs 抽象推理的双回路架构及其发展轨迹，为未来构建具备真正抽象推理能力的多模态模型提供了理论基础和方向指引。

Abstract: Vision Language Models (VLMs) excel on visual benchmarks but fail systematically on tasks requiring abstract reasoning. Existing benchmarks document this failure but cannot say \emph{why} it happens or which cognitive capability is missing. We close this gap by adopting the Relational Match-to-Sample (RMTS) paradigm from comparative and developmental psychology and pairing it with a mechanistic analysis of the model's internals. On a parametrically controlled stimulus set evaluated across frontier API models (GPT, Claude, Gemini) and three open-source families (Qwen3.5, Gemma-4, InternVL3), we identify four levers that shift VLMs toward the relational match---capability tier, model scale, the number of objects per scene, and the absence of per-object stimulus noise---together producing a developmental-like trajectory that mirrors the human \emph{relational shift}. Opening up the model, a per-layer representational similarity analysis and a causal mediation analysis reveal that VLM abstract reasoning is implemented by two competing circuits: an early circuit that organises images by their surface object features, and a late circuit that organises them by their abstract relation. Extending the analysis to ARC-AGI-1, we find that ablating the relational heads identified on RMTS degrades performance more than ablating random heads, indicating that the relational circuit is recruited beyond our controlled stimuli. We hope this mechanism-level view serves as a step toward understanding how abstract reasoning is implemented in VLMs.

</details>


### [283] [Where Rules End and Judges Begin: Measuring the Judgment Boundary in Multi-Agent Systems Security](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07657)
*Shaswata Mitra,Raj Patel,Subash Neupane,Sudip Mittal,Md Rayhanur Rahman,Shahram Rahimi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究提出DEFER1防御框架，通过28个检查步骤的级联机制，将攻击分为确定性拦截和交由四名裁判处理两类。在四个领域测试中，攻击成功率从约30.0%降至约3.0%，78%的攻击被确定性检查拦截。安全运营领域仅四分之一提案进入裁判环节，表明规则有效应对明确违规行为，而裁判负责意图模糊的情况。但系统仍存在风险评分门控误判问题，虽极少误放合法提案，却大量误批攻击提案，反映威胁评估的挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前多智能体系统防御方法通常孤立评估单一攻击类型，难以全面应对复杂、多样的对抗内容，且缺乏可审计性，亟需一种系统化、可扩展的综合防御框架。

Method: 将防御策略归纳为五项原则，构建DEFER1框架，采用级联式28步检查机制：先通过确定性规则拦截明显攻击，剩余样本交由四位裁判基于意图判断是否为攻击。

Result: 在四个独立领域测试中，攻击成功率从约30.0%显著下降至约3.0%；78%的攻击被确定性检查拦截；仅约25%的提案进入裁判环节，说明规则层已覆盖多数明确违规行为；但风险评分门控存在误判，虽对合法请求误判率低，却高估攻击提案，暴露威胁识别难点。

Conclusion: DEFER1框架通过规则与人工判断结合，实现高效、可审计的多智能体系统防御，但威胁评估仍面临准确性和平衡性的挑战，未来需优化评分机制以提升整体鲁棒性。

Abstract: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) engage tools, share memory, and delegate tasks, often encountering adversarial content. Current defenses for MAS are typically evaluated in isolation, focusing on one attack type at a time, which can lead to costly and hard-to-audit outcomes. This study organizes defenses into five principles, implementing them as DEFER1 (DEterministic-First Enforcement with Residual judgment), which includes a cascade of 28 checks that blocks what it can and refers the rest to a panel of four judges. In independent testing across four domains, attack success rates drop from about 30.0% to approximately 3.0%, with 78% of blocked attacks handled by deterministic checks. Only a quarter of proposals reach the judges in the security-operations domain, illustrating that the rules provide security for attacks violating clear policies, while judges manage those that only misrepresent intent. Both systems have weaknesses, such as a risk-score approval gate that inaccurately approves most attack proposals but few legitimate ones, highlighting the challenges in assessing threats accurately.

</details>


### [284] [Massive Activation Gating Channel in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07661)
*Minjia Mao,Shi Chen,Bowen Yin,Xiao Fang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文揭示了大型语言模型中大规模激活现象的机制，发现其由输入嵌入到脉冲前馈网络（FFN）中的单一通道——即大规模激活门控通道（MAGC）控制。该通道位置在特定模型中固定，当其值足够大或小（取决于模型），脉冲FFN输出将产生大规模激活。通过分析六种不同模型家族和规模的LLM，验证了MAGC的存在及其影响，并从理论上解释：当MAGC值极端时，FFN输出渐近简化为一个混合其下投影矩阵少数列的二次形式，这些列具有大规模激活的形态，从而导致输出出现大规模激活。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解大规模激活在大型语言模型中如何随令牌传播而出现，特别是其背后的机制，以提升对模型内部行为的认知。

Method: 通过实验分析多个大型语言模型，识别并验证输入嵌入中对大规模激活起决定作用的单一通道（MAGC）；结合数学推导，提供理论解释，说明MAGC如何通过使输出渐近为特定二次形式，诱导大规模激活。

Result: 在六种不同架构和规模的大型语言模型中均发现并验证了大规模激活门控通道（MAGC）的存在；理论分析表明，当MAGC值极端时，脉冲FFN输出会退化为混合部分下投影矩阵列的二次形式，从而引发大规模激活。

Conclusion: 大规模激活的出现由输入嵌入中固定的单个通道（MAGC）控制，该通道通过引导脉冲FFN输出进入一种特定的二次形式，导致大规模激活。这一发现为理解大型语言模型中隐藏的动态机制提供了新的视角。

Abstract: Massive activations, a phenomenon in which a small number of hidden channels exhibit exceptionally large magnitudes, are pervasive in large language models (LLMs). However, the mechanism by which a token develops massive activations as it propagates through a pretrained LLM remains poorly understood. In this paper, we find that the emergence of massive activations is controlled by a single channel in the input embedding to a spike feed-forward network (FFN). The position of this channel is fixed for a particular LLM. We name this channel the massive activation gating channel (MAGC). When the value of the MAGC is sufficiently large (or small, depending on the LLM), the output of the spike FFN exhibits massive activations. Examining six LLMs across four model families and different model sizes, we verify the existence and effect of MAGC. We further provide a theoretical explanation of the mechanism by which MAGC induces massive activations. When the value of MAGC is sufficiently large (or small), the output of a spike FFN asymptotically reduces to a quadratic form that mixes a few columns of the down-projection matrix of the FFN. Since these columns exhibit the shape of massive activations, the output therefore exhibits massive activations.

</details>


### [285] [EIO-Agents: The Missing Semantic Layer for AI Agent Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07675)
*Fouad Bousetouane*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: EIO-Agents 提出了一种开放的可互操作 AI 代理评估规范，包含语义层（EIO）和记录层（PER），旨在解决当前评估缺乏明确证据与结论关联的问题。通过定义证据类型、行为谓词、证据契约、声明、证明状态等，实现评估过程的可解释、可验证与可追溯。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前 AI 代理在关键环境中部署时，评估结果常缺乏明确的语义标准，评分、裁判意见和追踪数据无法清晰说明证据的意义及其对决策的支持，导致评估不可靠且难以复现。

Method: 提出 EIO-Agents 规范，包含两部分：1）评价智能本体（EIO），提供基于类型证据、版本化行为谓词、证据契约、声明、见证规则、证明状态等的语义层；2）可移植评估记录（PER），作为评估全过程的唯一可验证记录，支持重新推导与解释。

Result: EIO-Agents 实现了评估过程的透明化、可解释性与可审计性，使评估从单纯分数和裁决转变为可独立验证的问责性产物。

Conclusion: 随着 AI 代理承担更多责任，评估必须超越分数和结论，成为具备可验证证据链的可信系统，EIO-Agents 为此提供了标准化的语义与记录框架。

Abstract: AI agents are entering production in increasingly consequential environments without a shared semantic standard for what their evaluations actually mean. Scores, traces, judge outputs, and multi juror findings are increasingly used to justify readiness and release decisions, yet they often do not specify what evidence supports a claim, what that evidence can establish, or how the claim leads to a decision. We introduce EIO-Agents, an open specification for interoperable AI agent evaluation built on two layers. The Evaluation Intelligence Ontology (EIO) provides the semantic layer through typed evidence, versioned behavioral predicates, evidence contracts, claims, witness rules, proof status, recurrence, and computable derivations for metrics, findings, controls, and PASS, REVIEW, or BLOCK decisions. The Portable Evaluation Record (PER) provides the system of record: a canonical, content addressed representation of one evaluation that preserves the evidence to decision chain and can be re derived, explained, and verified. Scores summarize, juries interpret, and traces record, but none of them define what the evidence means or what it can prove. EIO provides that missing semantic contract, while PER preserves the resulting evaluation as a portable and verifiable system of record. As AI agents assume greater operational responsibility, evaluation must become more than a collection of scores and verdicts; it must become an accountable artifact whose meaning, evidence, limitations, and decisions can be independently checked.

</details>


### [286] [BluffJAX: Adversarial Imperfect Information Games in JAX](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07686)
*Aryaman Reddi,Jan Peters,Carlo D'Eramo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: BluffJAX 是一个基于 JAX 的开源对抗性不完美信息博弈套件，支持高吞吐量模拟和 GPU 并行化。包含德州扑克、库恩扑克等经典游戏，以及此前未在强化学习中广泛研究的布夫、七张牌扑克和肯普斯等新游戏，旨在推动博弈论方法在 RL 领域的研究。该套件在单/多 GPU 设置下表现出高达每秒数亿样本的吞吐量，优于现有 CPU/GPU 库。同时提供了 RL、树搜索和博弈求解算法的基准结果，便于后续研究对比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为强化学习领域提供多样化的不完美信息博弈环境，推动新型博弈论方法研究，并解决现有工具在高性能并行计算方面的不足。

Method: 基于 JAX 实现多种不完美信息博弈的标准化环境，优化模拟性能与内存使用，支持多 GPU 并行训练与大规模采样。

Result: BluffJAX 在单/多 GPU 环境下实现每秒数亿样本的高吞吐量，显著优于传统库；提供了多种算法的基准测试结果，可作为未来研究的参考标准。

Conclusion: BluffJAX 为强化学习中的不完美信息博弈研究提供了高效、可扩展且多样化的平台，有望激发新的研究方向。

Abstract: We introduce BluffJAX: an open-source suite of adversarial imperfect information games in JAX. We provide canonical implementations of games designed for high simulation throughputs and parallelization on GPU accelerators. Our suite consists of well-studied benchmarks such as Texas Hold'Em Poker and Kuhn Poker, as well as games that have not been previously studied in reinforcement learning research, such as Bluff, Stud Poker, and Kemps. We hope that implementing a variety of game mechanics and difficulties will introduce new challenges and foster novel research directions in game-theoretic methods for RL. We benchmark the throughput performance and memory usage of our environments in single and multi-GPU settings, demonstrating scaling of up to hundreds of millions of samples per second, and motivating the usage of BluffJAX over related GPU and CPU-based libraries. We benchmark reinforcement learning, tree search, and game-solving algorithms in JAX in order to provide users with baseline results and facilitate future comparisons.

</details>


### [287] [On the Boundary of Admission Gates: An Injected-Truth Study of Falsification-First Selection in Quantitative Strategy Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07701)
*Tianlun Zheng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究探讨了投资策略发现中的两个核心问题：找到盈利规则与验证该发现是否为搜索幸运。通过引入注入真实性的协议和随机准入控制，研究发现，只有当筛选标准优于随机控制时，才能提供有效信息而非仅提高门槛。在弱信号环境下，筛选标准可消除虚假发现，但将采纳率降至1-7%；在强信号下则无额外收益。此外，基于绝对收益而非超额收益的标准会错误排除所有候选策略，包括真正有效的策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前策略研究混淆了寻找盈利规则与验证其非偶然性的问题。现有方法缺乏对筛选标准有效性及其成本的实证检验，尤其在多重检验和回测过拟合背景下，亟需建立可靠的准入机制以避免虚假发现。

Method: 提出一种注入真实性的实验设计，结合随机准入控制作为基准，比较不同筛选标准的实际表现。通过合成数据和真实校准面板进行测试，评估各类标准在不同信号强度下的表现，重点分析其对虚假发现率和采纳率的影响。

Result: 在弱信号场景中，筛选标准能有效减少虚假发现，但显著降低采纳率（1-7%）；在强信号场景中，筛选标准无额外增益。基于绝对收益的标准会系统性排除所有真实信号，导致无效策略被误拒。

Conclusion: 筛选标准的有效性取决于其相对于随机控制的表现。仅靠提高门槛无法保证结果可靠性，必须基于超额收益构建标准，否则将误删真正有效的策略。该研究揭示了现有方法在应对回测过拟合和虚假发现方面的局限性。

Abstract: Strategy research conflates two problems: finding a profitable rule, and establishing that the finding is not search luck. The latter calls for admission gates -- statistical criteria that must be satisfied before a conclusion is adopted -- yet whether gates work, and at what cost, remains untested. We introduce an injected-truth protocol with a random-admission control that adopts at the same rate as the gate; only if the gate beats this control does it carry information rather than merely raise a threshold. Across synthetic and real-calibrated panels, gates eliminate false discoveries in the weak-signal regime but cut adoption to 1--7%, and add nothing when signals are strong. Most importantly, criteria computed on absolute rather than excess returns silently reject every candidate, including true signals. Keywords: multiple testing, backtest overfitting, strategy admission, injected-truth validation, excess returns, false discovery rate

</details>


### [288] [AgentMemGate: Addressing Speculation Contamination in Conversational Assistant Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07707)
*Chirag Sharma,Benjamin Fowlersmith,Karime Maamari*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出AgentMemGate，一种用于对话AI长期记忆的写时门控机制，以防止用户未完成计划的推测性陈述被错误地存入记忆。通过将提取的语句分类为推测、已完成事件、更正或其他，确保推测仅在条件满足后才进入记忆。研究构建了一个包含多轮对话的数据集，用于评估记忆准确性。实验表明，使用AgentMemGate可将记忆污染从87.5%降至0%，任务准确率从65%提升至95%；在更具挑战性的测试集上，污染降低至3.4%-5.7%，准确率提高9-13个百分点。主要瓶颈是字段匹配不足，导致许多真实推测无法被识别。代码与数据已公开。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有对话系统长期记忆存在‘推测污染’问题，即用户未完成的计划（如‘我想搬去西雅图’）被错误记录为已实现状态，导致后续交互错误。传统基准测试忽略中间状态和未解决的推测，无法有效检测此类错误。因此需要一种机制在写入记忆前识别并管理推测性陈述。

Method: 提出AgentMemGate，一个基于写时的分类门控系统，对从用户消息中提取的陈述进行分类：推测、已完成事件、更正或其它。推测不立即进入记忆，而是根据预设条件决定是否提升或删除。同时构建了一个包含147个对话的多轮对话数据集，涵盖计划确认、放弃或未决状态，用于评估系统性能。

Result: 在核心基准测试中，相比未加门控的管道，AgentMemGate将记忆污染从87.5%降至0%，任务准确率从65%提升至95%。在更具挑战性的持留测试集上，污染控制在3.4%-5.7%之间，任务准确率提升9至13个百分点。分析发现，字段匹配是当前主要瓶颈，许多真实推测因无对应字段而无法进入门控系统。

Conclusion: AgentMemGate有效解决了对话系统中由未完成计划引起的推测污染问题，显著提升记忆准确性和任务表现。未来工作需改进字段匹配能力以进一步减少漏检。数据集、提示和评估代码已开源，促进领域发展。

Abstract: Conversational AI assistants with long-term memory extract facts from user messages into a store consulted in later conversations. A stated plan can enter that store as fact: a user who might move to Seattle may be recorded as already living there. We call this speculation contamination. Final-state memory benchmarks miss this error because they do not probe intermediate state and include few unresolved speculations. We present AgentMemGate, a write-time gate for profile-store memory that classifies extracted statements as speculation, completed event, correction, or other. Speculations remain outside memory, with conditions governing later promotion or deletion. We also contribute a dataset of multi-session conversations in which plans are confirmed, abandoned, or left unresolved. On our 147-conversation held-out set, Mem0 and Graphiti assert unresolved plans as current state for 35.2% and 27.3% of pending plans. On the core benchmark, AgentMemGate eliminates all observed contamination relative to the identical ungated pipeline (87.5% to zero for the most exposed extraction style) and raises task accuracy from 65% to 95%. On the harder held-out set, gated contamination is 3.4% to 5.7% and task accuracy rises by 9 to 13 percentage points. Our analysis identifies field matching as the main remaining bottleneck: realistic speculations often match no profile field and never reach the gate. We release our datasets, prompts, and evaluation code.

</details>


### [289] [Evidence Before Sampling: Interpretable Implicit Negative Candidate Discovery for Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07708)
*Shreya Rajpal,Sonia Sharma,Swapnil Parekh,Lisa Li,Jeyendran Balakrishnan,Nagaraj Janardhana,Andrew Mattarella-Micke*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种可解释的隐式负样本发现方法，通过符号规则识别支持用户未交互行为的模式，并结合大模型与业务目标进行解释，提升负样本选择的合理性与推荐系统性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在真实世界推荐场景中，显式负反馈通常不可用，而传统负采样方法将未观察到的交互简单视为负例，缺乏解释性且可能不准确，尤其在商业场景下需确保负信号与业务目标一致。

Method: 首先通过观察到的用户-物品行为模式挖掘潜在的隐式负样本；利用符号规则编码这些模式，并基于支持度、信息量和产品相关性进行评分；按证据强度排序保留规则；再使用大语言模型结合业务知识对规则进行解释，最终生成融合统计证据与业务理解的报告。

Result: 在工业级B2B场景及五个公开数据集上评估表明，该方法在候选负样本质量上优于基线，且在下游任务中相比随机采样提升PR-AUC达12.5%（每正例四个负例）。结果验证了负样本有效性可独立于推荐性能评估，实现可解释、业务对齐的负样本选择。

Conclusion: 本方法实现了证据驱动、业务对齐且可解释的负样本选择，在稀疏、偏斜的真实推荐环境中显著提升了模型训练质量与系统可解释性。

Abstract: Recommender systems learn from observed user-item interactions, but explicit negative feedback is often unavailable. Since deep learning models require negative signals for training, negative sampling methods typically treat selected unobserved interactions as negatives. However, a missing interaction does not explain why a user is uninterested in an item or whether there is sufficient evidence to label it negative. This is especially important in business recommendation, where negative signals should be interpretable and aligned with business objectives. We formulate implicit negative candidate discovery to identify unobserved interactions supported by observed customer behavior. We encode these patterns as symbolic rules, score them based on support, informativeness, and product relevance, and rank the retained rules by evidence. An LLM then interprets the retained rules using business objectives and domain knowledge; the interpretations are combined with the statistical evidence in the final report. We evaluate our method in an industrial B2B setting and across five public recommendation datasets. Candidate-quality evaluations in the industrial setting and three public datasets show higher precision than the evaluated baselines, while symbolic selection improves downstream test PR-AUC by 12.5% over random selection with four negatives per positive example in the industrial task. Our results show that negative candidate validity can be evaluated separately from downstream recommendation performance. This distinction enables evidence-based, business-aligned, and explainable negative selection, improving both interpretability and model training in sparse, skewed, real-world recommendation settings.

</details>


### [290] [PERSIST: Who-What-When Memory Across Sessions for Full-Duplex Spoken Dialogue](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07725)
*Achira Lin,Siyuan Hou,Wenyi Yu,Xinnian Zhao,Haoyu Niu,Wang Geng,Longshuai Xiao,Shihai Xiao,Mangsuo Zhao,Chao Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: PERSIST 是一个用于多会话、多说话人语音对话的持久记忆系统，通过显式建模谁（Who）、什么（What）和何时（When）来实现跨会话历史的结构化存储与高效检索。它采用3W联合评分机制，结合语义内容、声学说话人身份和时间状态，支持实时全双工交互，并通过复用对话骨干网络的中间表示，将检索延迟从578.42毫秒降低至7.03毫秒。研究还提出SpokenTrace诊断基准，用于分解评估记忆任务与说话人-查询类型，揭示召回、说话人归属和时间状态追踪中的失败。在SpokenTrace上，PERSIST达到85.08%的端到端任务准确率，且所有支持的EM@3从BGE-large的49.01%提升至82.10%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代语音助手常被多个用户共享，需能回答关于早期对话的问题（如“我最初计划什么时候离开？”）或根据过往互动个性化行为，这要求系统不仅能检索主题相似的内容，还需识别当前说话人、恢复相关过去状态并区分后续修改。现有方法难以同时处理说话人身份、语义内容和时间状态的复杂耦合，因此亟需一种能够显式建模‘谁、什么、何时’的持久记忆系统。

Method: 提出PERSIST系统，将跨会话历史结构化为可读事件记录；设计3W联合评分机制，融合语义内容、声学说话人身份和时间状态进行检索；利用对话骨干网络的中间表示避免重复编码，实现低延迟实时检索；构建SpokenTrace诊断基准，按记忆任务和说话人-查询类型对性能进行细粒度评估。

Result: 在SpokenTrace基准上，PERSIST实现85.08%的端到端任务准确率，所有支持的EM@3从BGE-large的49.01%提升至82.10%；检索延迟由578.42毫秒降至7.03毫秒，显著提升实时性与可用性。

Conclusion: PERSIST通过显式建模‘谁、什么、何时’，有效解决了多用户、多会话语音对话中持久记忆的关键挑战，在准确性与实时性方面均取得显著提升，为下一代智能语音助手提供了可靠的记忆架构。

Abstract: Modern voice assistants may be shared by multiple users and should be able to answer questions about earlier conversations such as "When did I originally plan to leave?" or adapt their behavior to individual users based on past interactions. This requires more than retrieving a topically similar passage: the assistant must identify the current speaker, recover the relevant past state, and distinguish it from later revisions. We present PERSIST, a persistent memory system for multi-session, multi-speaker spoken dialogue that explicitly models Who, What, and When. PERSIST structures cross-session histories into readable event records and retrieves them with a 3W joint scoring mechanism that combines semantic content, acoustic speaker identity, and temporal state. For real-time full-duplex interaction, PERSIST further reuses intermediate representations from the dialogue backbone, avoiding query-audio re-encoding and reducing retrieval latency from 578.42 ms to 7.03 ms. We also introduce SpokenTrace, a diagnostic benchmark that factorizes evaluation along memory tasks and speaker-query types, exposing failures in recall, speaker attribution, and temporal-state tracking. On SpokenTrace, PERSIST achieves 85.08% end-to-end task accuracy and improves all-support EM@3 from 49.01% with BGE-large to 82.10%.

</details>
